## Kingston FURY Beast 16GB DDR5

A single 16GB DDR5 module running at 5200 MT/s for the latest Intel and AMD platforms.

- 16 GB capacity, DDR5-5200
- Low-profile heat spreader
- Intel XMP 3.0 ready
